bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated implicitly as a sub-category of toxicity ('racism') and hate speech. The paper measures the model's attack prevention rate against adversarial prompt injections (such as Middle Filling attacks) using an LLM safety critic on the LMSYS-MF benchmark.

Evaluated implicitly as a sub-category of toxicity ('sexism', 'misgendering') and hate speech. Measured via the model's robustness against generating harmful adversarial completions on the LMSYS-MF benchmark.

Monitored implicitly as a sub-category of toxicity ('ageism'). The methodology uses a trained LLM safety critic to dynamically detect and backtrack from unsafe, ageist text generated during autoregressive output.
Evaluated explicitly through the 'Politics' safety category by measuring the model's attack prevention rate against adversarial jailbreak prompts on the LMSYS-MF benchmark.
